4. Upon receipt of the requisition from Para Medical Council, the certificates of 20 candidates were verified and found to have been forged.
Various discrepancies were found in those certificates.
The students in whose names the certificate were issued were not registered with university.
The degree and diploma certificates were fabricated.
The letterheads and seals of the university were also forged.
It further transpired that the applicant was one of the persons who had sold those fabricated degree and diploma certificates to those students.
Hence, the report.
5. Apprehending arrest, the applicant approached the Court of Session.
By an order dated 11th September, 2023, the Court of Session declined to exercise the discretion in favour of the applicant.
Hence, this application.
